cities.name: Riga
cities.local_food_tip: Latvian comfort food means veggie soups, potatoes, beet dishes, rye bread and pastries — jednostavno, čisto i toplo.
cities.full_day:
Morning: 🏰 Riga Old Town: Cobbled alleys, towers and colorful squares. → 🏛️ House of the Blackheads (Exterior). → ☕ Cozy Old Town café.

Afternoon: 🏛️ Art Nouveau District (Alberta iela): Stunning facades and decorative buildings. → 🌿 Esplanade Park. → 🍽️ Lunch: Veggie soups, potato dishes, salads. → 🎨 Latvian National Museum of Art (Exterior).

Sunset: 🌅 Daugava Riverside Promenade.

Night: 🌃 Old Town lantern-lit streets + dessert bars.
public_transport_tips: 🚋 Trams are the best way to move around.

city_events.name: Riga City Festival
city_events.description: 🎉 Open-air music, culture and river events.

cities.name: Daugavpils
cities.local_food_tip: Simple Baltic dishes — soups, potatoes, bread and pastries.
cities.full_day:

Afternoon: 🎨 Rothko Art Center (Exterior). → 🍽️ Lunch: Veg soups, salads. → 🏛️ City center stroll.

Sunset: 🌅 River viewpoints.

Night: 🌃 Calm evening streets.
